provenance_note: Hand-derived from 132.0-B-3 §4.1.2 (the Primary Header), §4.1.3 (the Secondary Header), §4.1.4.6 and Annex D (OID frames), §4.1.5, §4.2.4-4.2.5 and docs/04-engines.md §2.3 (LNK-030…LNK-036, LNK-076), docs/standards/common-link-features.md §3, OI-11 (D2 of the M4 plan). Model test-vectors/models/link_send.py, written blind (TV-023) by a Claude agent from the Blue Books and docs/ only, without reading any implementation. The input scripts were chosen by hand; the expected outputs are the model's. The file is written by the model (--write) and never edited by hand.

scenarios.description: With no VC offering, each Opportunity returns an OID frame on the dedicated VC 7: FHP 0x7FE, data from the OID generator, which continues across frames; the MC and VC Frame Counts count the OID frames.
A frame of an offered field (VC 2, FHP 5), then an OID frame; the MC Frame Count counts both, the VC Frame Count of VC 7 starts at 0 for the OID frame.
The MC Frame Count increments for every frame of the channel, the VC Frame Count for every frame of its VC, assigned in the order of transmission.
258 OID frames: the MC Frame Count and the VC Frame Count of VC 7 (8 bits) return to 0 after 255; the OID generator continues without a restart.
Fixed priority: the offered VC with the highest priority (VC 2 over 3 over 1) goes first; a VC that offers later goes before a lower one that waited.

Round robin in ascending VCID order, wrapping, from the VC served last: with all of VC 1, 2, 3 always offering, 1 2 3 1 2 3; VCs that do not offer are skipped; the first selection after start-up is the lowest VCID.
Round robin skips a VC with no field and wraps: only VC 1 and VC 3 offer; after VC 3 comes VC 1.
Weighted round robin with weights VC 1: 2, VC 2: 1, VC 3: 3 (VC 7, which never offers, has weight 1 and forfeits its turn): with every VC backlogged the order of turns is 1 1 2 3 3 3 repeated.

A VC that has no field forfeits the rest of its turn: VC 3 (weight 3) is served once, with two selections of its turn left; at the next Opportunity it has no field, so VC 7 forfeits too and VC 1 is served.

A VC_OCF slot, initialised by the configuration and replaced by SetOcf, is inserted in every frame of its VC (the OCF Flag is set, the data field is 4 octets shorter); a VC without it has none; the OID frame carries the OCF of its VC.

An MC_OCF and an MC_FSH are in every frame of the master channel, the OID frame included; SetOcf and SetFsh replace the slots; a Secondary Header of the wrong length is refused with LengthMismatch (fsh_len).
A VC_FSH of 3 data octets: the Secondary Header Flag, the ID octet (length - 1) and the data are in each frame of that VC and not in the others.

A VC with a 4-octet Security Header and a 2-octet Security Trailer: the frame has them as zero octets and the action gives their ranges and the range of the data; FECF and the others stay as built (the FECF is not yet computed).

At most one offered field per VC: a second Offer for the same VC is refused with WouldBlock and no state change; an Offer for an unknown VC is refused; Opportunity consumes the slot of the VC it selects; SetOcf, SetFsh and SetInsert give no action.
Reconfigure discards the offered fields (Discarded, with the octets) but not the OID generator nor the frame counts (132.0 4.1.2.5.3, 4.1.4.6.2.1): the OID data and the counts continue.
